calls.statement:
SELECT cp.subcategory AS asis_sub, p.subcategory AS aswas_sub, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, SUM(f.quantity) FILTER (WHERE f.staff_purchase_flag) AS staff_units, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, SUM(f.quantity) FILTER (WHERE f.quantity<=0) AS nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=107 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5 AND (cp.subcategory='Cleaning Products' OR p.subcategory='Cleaning Products') AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL

(1 row)

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_week, count(*) lines, SUM(f.quantity) units, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dl, max(f.etl_loaded_at) loaded
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=107 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5 AND cp.subcategory='Cleaning Products'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) rows_, SUM(r.quantity_returned) returned_units, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dr
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=107 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.subcategory='Cleaning Products'

WITH mine AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date AS dt, SUM(f.quantity) u, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=107 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id<>999
 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM mine) days_mine, (SELECT SUM(u) FROM mine) units_mine, (SELECT SUM(rc) FROM mine) rc_mine,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=107 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') days_rpt,
 (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=107 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') units_rpt,
 (SELECT SUM(receipts) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=107 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') rc_rpt
